title: HR Administrator
description:
People & Operations Assistant

Caversham, Reading
£28,000 - £32,000 per annum
Full-time Office-based (5 days per week)

Reed HR are delighted to be partnering with a growing and people-focused organisation in Caversham to recruit a People & Operations Assistant.

This is an excellent opportunity for an organised and proactive HR professional looking to develop their career within a busy and supportive People team. The successful candidate will play a key role in supporting the employee lifecycle, ensuring HR administration is delivered accurately, efficiently and confidentially.

The Role

Reporting to the People & Operations Manager, you will provide comprehensive administrative support across all areas of HR and People Operations. This varied position offers exposure to recruitment, onboarding, employee relations, payroll administration, training coordination and HR projects.

Key responsibilities include:
- Maintaining employee records and HR systems, ensuring data accuracy and confidentiality.
- Supporting recruitment activities, onboarding and offboarding processes.
- Preparing HR documentation including contracts, letters and employee correspondence.
- Assisting with payroll administration and monthly payroll inputs.
- Monitoring and maintaining holiday and sickness absence records.
- Coordinating training activities and compliance requirements.
- Responding to employee and manager queries in a professional and timely manner.
- Supporting the review and maintenance of company policies and procedures.
- Assisting with employee relations processes and case administration.
- Producing HR reports and management information as required.
- Supporting wider People projects and initiatives across the business.

To be successful in this role, you will have:
- Previous experience within an HR Administration, HR Assistant or People Coordinator role.
- Good knowledge of HR practices and employment legislation.
- Strong administrative and organisational skills with excellent attention to detail.
- A professional and confidential approach to handling sensitive information.
- Excellent communication and interpersonal skills.
- Strong IT skills including Microsoft Office applications.
- The ability to manage multiple priorities and meet deadlines.
- A proactive approach with strong problem-solving skills.
- Payroll administration experience would be advantageous.
- CIPD Level 3 qualification or working towards this would be desirable but is not essential.

If you're an enthusiastic HR professional looking for your next challenge and keen to build your experience across the full employee lifecycle, we'd love to hear from you.

title: Clinic Coordinator
description:

- Aiding in the smooth running of the day to day of the clinic, plus front of house.

title: Accounts Assistant
description:
Robert Half are delighted to be partnering with a small, ambitious and friendly business based in Oxford. They are looking for an Accounts Assistant to take ownership of an important part of the financial operation.

This is a fantastic opportunity for someone with finance experience who enjoys variety, likes working with people as well as numbers, and wants to play a genuinely meaningful role within a growing, close-knit business.

The Role

Reporting into the finance team, you will play a key role in ensuring customer accounts are accurately maintained and payments are received and allocated promptly. You'll be working with customers from around the world across multiple currencies, and the role goes well beyond routine accounts receivable. You'll also liaise with sales and marketing colleagues, resolve customer queries, produce reports, and get involved in wider business projects.

Key responsibilities include:
- Allocating customer payments accurately against invoices and reconciling bank accounts
- Preparing and importing bank statements into Xero
- Proactively chasing outstanding debts by phone and email, maintaining accurate records of collection activity
- Managing the accounts receivable inbox and resolving customer queries promptly and professionally
- Producing and reviewing the monthly Aged Debtors Report
- Maintaining and updating debt-tracking spreadsheets and reports
- Supporting the wider finance function with ad hoc projects and administration

About You
- Previous experience in an accounts receivable, credit control or accounts assistant role
- Confident working with multiple currencies and reconciling accounts
- Strong communication skills, with the confidence to proactively chase payments
- Organised, accurate and comfortable managing a varied workload
- Experience with Xero (or similar accounting software) is desirable but not essential

What's on Offer
- Salary of up to £32,000, depending on experience
- Hybrid working - 3 days in the office, 2 days from home
- Discretionary annual bonus
- 25 days' holiday plus bank holidays, rising with service (up to 30 days)
- Early finish on Fridays
- Company pension scheme
- Quarterly team socials and Christmas party
- Free on-site parking
- The chance to join a small, fun team with genuine international reach

Apply Now

If you're looking for a varied finance role within a supportive, sociable team where you can make a real impact, we'd love to hear from you. Apply today or contact Robert Half's Oxford office for a confidential conversation.

Robert Half Ltd acts as an employment business for temporary positions and an employment agency for permanent positions. Robert Half is committed to diversity, equity and inclusion. Suitable candidates with equivalent qualifications and more or less experience can apply. Rates of pay and salary ranges are dependent upon your experience, qualifications and training. If you wish to apply, please read our Privacy Notice describing how we may process, disclose and store your personal data:

title: Administrator

The team delivers the full breadth of primary care services, from routine appointments and chronic disease management to urgent care and preventative health, ensuring every patient receives safe, effective, and compassionate support. Working closely with operational managers and senior leadership, the team oversees patient care delivery, appointment coordination, clinical record management, and service performance monitoring. The practice ensures that all services remain aligned with NHS standards and regulatory requirements, while upholding a commitment to delivering accessible, patient-centred care to the Kidlington community. The post-holder provides reliable and routine administrative support to ensure the smooth daily operation of the service. This role is designed for individuals with little or no prior administrative experience but who demonstrate motivation to learn, develop and contribute to team efficiency. Assist with the preparation of documents, medical reports, spreadsheets, and presentations underguidance from senior staff. Information Management Maintain accurate and well-organised records, documents, and filing systems. Ensure information is updated promptly and stored in accordance with organisational and NHS policies. Handle all data responsibly, ensuring confidentiality, accuracy, and compliance with data protection and governance standards. Communication and Coordination Provide courteous, professional, and timely responses to internal and external enquiries,including patients, callers, and colleagues. Support clear communication within the team by relaying messages, sharing information appropriately, and maintaining effective channels of contact. Act as a helpful first point of contact for telephone calls, emails, and general enquiries. Confidentiality, Compliance & Governance Manage sensitive information appropriately, following confidentiality requirements, data protection regulations (e.g., GDPR), and NHS governance policies. Team Contribution & Professional Development Work collaboratively with colleagues, contributing to a positive, supportive team environment. Show willingness to learn, adapt to new administrative systems and tools, and develop skills as required. Support the wider team to achieve service objectives efficiently, demonstrating reliability anda proactive approach to tasks.

title: Administrator
